For visitors

All riders are welcome. The host calls it a good recovery ride. Weather can cancel it.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 12:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the The Friday Lunch Ride group ride

The Friday Lunch Ride is a road and social group ride in Sparks, NV. It rolls every Friday at 12:00 pm from McClelland Laboratories.

A short ride that fits a lunch break, 18 to 23 miles from the Greg Street start in Sparks. The pace is easy to moderate and the host says everyone is welcome.
